_note: Friends. kind: chaotic (fun, money schemes, temptation) or grounded (stability, sensible doors). Hanging out uses a time slot, raises loyalty and has a flavour of effects; it can also move their storyline on (chain = their events in order, in events.json). minAge on a hang-out option keeps pubs for 18+.

friends.name: Deano
friends.trait: Your best mate from Sunday league. His business ideas get more ambitious as they get worse.

hang.label: Pint (of squash) at the Red Lion with Deano
lines: Deano pitches you a vape shop for dogs. You say no. He looks hurt, then pitches it again.
You play darts. Deano hits the barman. Everyone laughs, including the barman, eventually.

friends.name: Shaz
friends.trait: Throws the best parties in town. Also the loudest. Neighbours have a WhatsApp group about her.

hang.label: Help Shaz plan her next party
lines: Shaz wants a foam machine AND a petting zoo. You talk her down to just the foam.
You spend four hours choosing a playlist. It's all Steps.

friends.name: Big Lee
friends.trait: Wheeler-dealer. Always has a van. Never says what's in the van.

hang.label: Ride around in Big Lee's van
lines: Lee drops off 'some parcels'. You don't ask. You really don't ask.
Lee sells a fridge to a man who already has a fridge. Genius.

friends.name: Ty
friends.trait: Aspiring rapper and influencer. 312 followers. Says he's 'about to blow up'.

hang.label: Film content with Ty
lines: Ty films you doing keepy-uppies with an egg. The egg loses.
Ty's new track is called 'Big Ting Energy'. It's 11 minutes long.

friends.name: Priya
friends.trait: Your sensible mate from school, now studying accountancy. Reads the small print for fun.

hang.label: Coffee with Priya
lines: Priya explains compound interest with biscuits. You finally get it.
Priya asks what an agent's 'ten percent' is ten percent OF. You don't know. She's horrified.

friends.name: Mo
friends.trait: Physio student. Will talk about hamstrings at a wedding.

hang.label: Stretching session with Mo
lines: Mo finds a knot in your calf the size of a satsuma. Satisfying.
Mo makes you do yoga. You fall over in 'tree'. Twice.

friends.name: Jess
friends.trait: Grew up next door. Runs a youth charity on a shoestring and a lot of shouting.

hang.label: Help out at Jess's youth club
lines: You referee under-9s. You get booked by an under-9.
Jess makes you judge a talent show. A boy does magic. It goes badly. You love him.

friends.name: Stan
friends.trait: Your grandad's old mate. Played 400 games in the 70s. Has a story for everything, and everything is about mud.

hang.label: Tea and stories with Stan
lines: Stan played with a broken leg once. 'You just walk it off, son.' You don't think you can walk off a broken leg.
Stan says 'in my day' nineteen times. You count.

nightsOut.label: House party at Shaz's
lines: Someone's brought a karaoke machine. You did Bohemian Rhapsody. All of it. Every part.
The party ends when Shaz's mum gets home from bingo early.

nightsOut.label: Pub with the lads
lines: Quiz night. Your team, 'Quiz Team Aguilera', comes second to the pensioners.
Gaz does his dance. A man pays him to stop.

nightsOut.label: Big night out in town
lines: You lose your shoes. You find them in a kebab. Not near a kebab. In it.
You dance on a table. The table didn't consent.

nightsOut.label: VIP table, bottle service
lines: The bottle comes with sparklers and a man with a trumpet. You paid £1,500 for a man with a trumpet.
A reality TV star asks who you are. You ask who she is. Stalemate.

WHERE'S YOUR SHOES? {NAME}'S BAREFOOT KEBAB RUN
